title: fix: clarify docs drawer sections
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Highlights drawer section headings with the Pollinations yellow accent.
- Adds a fixed 12px gap before each section.
- Applies consistently to desktop and mobile drawers.

Tests: `npx vitest run test/docs.test.ts`

gist.headline: The docs got signposts
gist.blurb: The documentation drawer has a little more garden-path logic now. Section headings bloom in Pollinations yellow, with enough breathing room to avoid becoming one long hedge.
gist.summary: Updated the docs drawer on desktop and mobile so section headings use the Pollinations yellow accent and each section begins with a fixed 12px gap.
gist.impact: Readers can scan and navigate grouped documentation links more easily in either drawer layout.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a friendly librarian-gardener in a cozy documentation drawer shaped like a small bookshelf, placing bright lime-yellow section labels above neatly separated rows of code-scrolls. Small code-plants and flowers grow between the organized sections, making the improved spacing and hierarchy visibly clear.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and tiny librarian glasses, arranging a retro documentation bookshelf with glowing lime green (#ecf874) section labels and neatly spaced code-scroll sections; little flowers and code-plants grow in the gaps. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, dark purple (#110518) outlines, pixel-font text: 'DOCS'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
